{{Quote|Running low on bacta, sir. Okay on analgesics for the time being.|Clone Sergeant Coric, reporting the resources available to the aid station to Clone Captain CT-7567 "Rex"|audio=Coric-bacta.flac|<ref name="SW:TCWN" />}}
Located on<ref name="SW:TCWN" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[planet]]<ref name="Christophsis SWE">{{SWE|locations|christophsis|Christophsis}}</ref> [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Chaleydonia]], the '''forward aid station''' was situated inside a colonnaded doorway in a building near the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] perimeter during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]. The aid depot was equipped with a number of medical supplies, as well as scattered crates for injured [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to sit on as they were operated upon.<ref name="SW:TCWN" />

The aid station was used during the Battle of Christophsis by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]<ref name="SW:TCWN" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Coric]] provided medical services to [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Ged]] after the trooper was injured while defending the Republic's perimeter during a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] attack. After the counterattack, Coric reported to [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] "Rex" that the station was running low on [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] supplies, but was well stocked in [[Painkiller/Legends|pain killers]]. Additionally, Rex used the station to give him a respite as he cut his [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="SW:TCWN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The forward aid station first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[2008]] film [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']]. The novelization was written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published the same year.<ref name="SW:TCWN" />
